text:
maria: Quick design sync — spotted two things in the heatmap + time-range handoff: VoiceOver doesn't announce the scrubber handle, and in compact mode the bucket labels collapse (no way to tell which percentile band you're over). Screenshot: https://img.redwood/heatmap-compact.png alex: Hmm, good catch. I noticed compact hides the labels to save space but that definitely breaks discoverability. jamal: For VoiceOver the scrubber should be a slider with aria attributes. Also the preview tooltip needs an aria-live so screen readers get the hover value. sam: Copy nudge: the sampling toggle label currently says "Sampling" — can we change to "Sample rate" + tooltip? People confuse it with sampling strategy. :thinking_face: ben: UX thought — when compact is enabled, show abbreviated bucket labels (e.g., "p95", "p99") on hover or persistent on focus. That keeps density but keeps info accessible. maria: Agree on both. Jamal, can you paste the aria snippet you'd want? Alex, can we keep the sticky presets (Last 15m/1h) in compact mode? jamal: Something like:```html
Preview: p95 = 183ms ``` And add `aria-colindex` on heatmap cells so VoiceOver can say "bucket 3 of 12". alex: That looks good. I can wire `aria-live` and `role=slider` today. For compact bucket labels, I can add focused label overlays (keyboard + focusable) so it doesn't rely on hover. sam: Also check color contrast on the p95 badge in compact — a11y-bot flagged it earlier. Maybe a 2px stroke or slightly darker fill. a11y-bot: Axe: color-contrast failed on .p95-badge (ratio 3.8:1). Recommendation: increase contrast to at least 4.5:1 for normal text. ben: For copy: "Sample rate" tooltip copy suggestion: "Controls how frequently we sample traces for heatmap aggregation. Lower rates reduce cost but increase noise." Shorter variant for mobile: "How often we sample traces." maria: Solid. Action items: 1) Alex implement slider & focus overlays. 2) Jamal add aria-live + colindex guidance in the PR description. 3) Sam update p95 badge colors and microcopy. I'll file tickets: UI-4523 (compact heatmap accessibility & labels), A11Y-312 (scrubber aria + contrast). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
